name: Derivative Workflow Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of exchange's notice of change on a derivative.

PREL.name: Preliminary
PREL.definition: Notice is an advance warning that an adjustment may be applied.

ADJU.name: Adjustment
ADJU.definition: Notice confirms that an adjustment will be applied.

NOAC.name: No Action
NOAC.definition: Notice confirms that no adjustment will be applied.

UCON.name: Unconfirmed
UCON.definition: GCA VS (Global Corporate Actions Validation Service) is unable to confirm that there is a corporate action corresponding to this notice.

DLTD.name: Deleted
DLTD.definition: Details were entered in error. All data should be ignored.
